reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Service connections that use `Direct-Server-Return` and were established prior to Cilium v1.13.3 will be disrupted, and need to be re-established", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: workload-failure

consequence.statement: Service connections using Direct-Server-Return that were established prior to Cilium v1.13.3 will be disrupted and need to be re-established.

proposed.statement: Service connections using Direct-Server-Return that were established before Cilium v1.13.3 will be disrupted on upgrade and must be re-established.
